component.name: Mothball
component.summary: Put idle projects away, get your disk back

description.p: Mothball finds build output you can regenerate, such as node_modules, target, .venv and build folders, in projects you have not touched in a while, and moves it to the Trash to free disk space.
It never touches files tracked by git, skips projects with uncommitted work, and can restore any project later with its usual install command. Autopilot can keep a chosen amount of space free.
